data.name: Heliodor
data.gender_notes: Heliodor is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word helios, meaning sun, and doron, meaning gift. Heliodor can be interpreted as 'sun-gifted' or 'gift of the sun'. In Christianity, Saint Heliodor was a Greek saint and martyr who is said to have been a doctor who was martyred during the persecutions of Decius in the early 3rd century AD. The name Heliodor carries the meaning “Sun-gifted” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek. Parents who choose Heliodor usually hope their child will grow to embody sun-gifted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the light of faith, illuminating the path of the believer.
data.etymology: Heliodor belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun-gifted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heliodor total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Ἠλιόδωρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἠλιόδωρος (Ἠλιόδωρος) συνδυάζει τὰ ἡλιος (ήλιος) καὶ δωρον (δῶρον), σημαίνοντας 'δῶρον τοῦ ἡλίου'. Σπάνιος ὀνομάζεται σὲ νεογέννητα τοῦ Χριστιανισμοῦ, συμβολίζοντας τὴν πηγή τοῦ φωτός καὶ τῆς ζωῆς.

data.cultural_impact: The name Heliodor emphasizes the ancient Greek influence on Christian naming practices, showcasing the blending of cultures and beliefs. Heliodor could have been a name given to a child born during periods of Hellenized Christianity or in communities where Greek culture held significant influence.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of Heliodor lies in its meaning as a 'sun-gifted' or 'gift of the sun'. This name can be taken as a reminder of the spiritual gifts bestowed upon us by God, just as the sun provides us with the physical gifts of light and warmth. The name also brings to mind the idea of the sun as a symbol of Christ, the Son of God, shedding light in the world. Ultimately, Heliodor serves as a reminder that all good gifts come from God and that we are to use these gifts in service to Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Heliodor means "gift of the sun God" in Greek. It symbolizes the light and divine grace bestowed upon an individual. It is a name of hope and enlightenment, reminding us of the radiant power of the sun and the warmth of God's love.

historical_references.reference: Heliodorus was a Greek treasurer who seized the temple treasures of Jerusalem in 162 BC and brought them to Antioch, where they were used to finance the campaign of Antiochus VII against his brother Demetrius II. This event is described in the historical works of Josephus and Appian.
historical_references.context: Annexation of Judea by the Seleucid Empire

historical_references.reference: Another Heliodorus was a bishop of Thessalonica in the late 4th century AD. He was a prominent leader in the Orthodox Church and is chiefly known for his role in the First Council of Constantinople in 330 AD, where he advocated for the primacy of the bishop of Constantinople over the bishops of the Eastern provinces.
historical_references.context: Theological debates within the Early Christian Church
